comment: The noise knob is dead. src/U.cpp:145 bounds the channel loop with maxPolySpecial, which returns the signal input's channel count, and an unpatched input reports zero channels; the noise branch at lines 149-154 only runs when that same input is not connected, so it can never be reached and the filter frequency the knob sets is never used. The knob is on the panel and can be clicked, so it gets a line saying so rather than falling back on the maker's tooltip. The README describes the noise as what the module produces when no input is patched; the code does not do that, and this is the one place where the manual and the code disagree outright. The quantiser takes half a step off the held value and then truncates toward zero (src/U.cpp:92-97 and 159), so the step boundaries fall differently above and below 0V. The panel prints QUNT, NSE, CLK, IN, OUT and QOUT, the last four repeated for each of the three sections.
